controls.quote: must record a documented rationale wherever the submitted number deviates from the agent's baseline

controls.name: Acknowledgement-receipt of downside scenario by submitters
controls.quote: acknowledgement-receipt mechanism confirming submitters received and will apply the downside scenario

controls.name: Offline / multi-channel distribution and submission path as first-class channel
controls.quote: distributed through both a central portal and a downloadable, lockable template bundle

controls.name: Manual override/correction path for non-integrated HRIS/headcount data
controls.quote: A manual override/correction path is retained at the cost-centre-owner level where HRIS/payroll data does not fully integrate

controls.name: Stale/failed data feed halts agent and routes to human instead of interpolating
controls.quote: If a data feed is stale or a scenario run fails validation, the agent halts and routes to the FP&A manager

controls.name: Materiality-triggered re-issue of assumptions mid-cycle
controls.quote: any mid-cycle revision carries a version stamp

controls.name: Documented methodology / basis-of-judgment for FX rates and downside scenario
controls.quote: Downside macro scenario (authored, basis-of-judgment note attached)

controls.name: Target-setting reserved to CEO/CFO; analytics/agent decision support only, no write authority
controls.quote: the target itself is a human governance decision, not an agent output with an override option

controls.name: Top-down targets issued with stated reasoning/drivers
controls.quote: Provisional top-down targets with stated reasoning/drivers

controls.name: Provisional targets with scheduled recalibration touchpoint
controls.quote: A recalibration touchpoint is scheduled once first-pass bottom-up submissions land

controls.name: Deterministic hard gate blocking above-threshold capex without business case
controls.quote: A deterministic, rule-based gate blocks submission of any capex line above the published threshold unless a business case is attached

controls.name: Named human reviewer (CFO/capex committee) signs off above-threshold business case, decision logged
controls.quote: above-threshold cases are paired with a named central FP&A reviewer/coach

controls.name: Capex exception path logged and attributable
controls.quote: Any exception path is logged and attributable.

controls.name: Capital-allocation triage with inspectable scoring and human routing of FX/political-risk requests
controls.quote: any request with material FX or political-risk exposure must be routed to a human reviewer rather than resolved by templated scoring

controls.name: Deterministic, version-pinned, inspectable FX/policy logic in consolidation (no agent inference, single reused logic)
controls.quote: FX translation and policy application are deterministic, rule-based and auditable, not generative inference

controls.name: Halt-and-escalate on reconciliation break / exception (no silent plug)
controls.quote: reconciliation breaks, unmapped inputs or FX/policy anomalies hard-stop and route back to the originating T3/T4 submission(s)

controls.name: Versioned consolidation run log (inputs, assumption vintage, logic version, timestamp)
controls.quote: Each consolidation run is versioned and logged (inputs, assumption vintage, agent/logic version, timestamp)

controls.name: Named analyst certification of a discrete reconciled consolidation snapshot
controls.quote: The FP&A analyst remains the accountable reviewer of consolidation output, certifying exceptions and the final reconciled statement.

controls.name: Completeness/data-quality gate on submissions before consolidation
controls.quote: An explicit completeness/data-quality gate checks that no submission has been silently treated as zero or omitted.

controls.name: Intercompany identification and elimination with log/schedule
controls.quote: Reconciliation and intercompany-elimination log

controls.name: Exchange differences itemised, never netted
controls.quote: Exchange differences are preserved as explicit, itemised lines, never netted invisibly.

controls.name: Documented manual/spreadsheet consolidation fallback using same policy/FX inputs
controls.quote: A documented, equally-valid spreadsheet-based consolidation path exists for units without reliable system/FX-feed access

controls.name: Trained backup for consolidation/FX function (key-person risk)
controls.quote: at least one trained backup must exist for this function given talent-concentration risk

controls.name: Consolidation roll-up split from a separate human reconciliation/validation step
controls.quote: Three-statement reconciliation and validation

controls.name: Bounded review iterations with non-convergence escalation path
controls.quote: Iterations are capped (e.g. two structured rounds) and timeboxed against the T1 calendar

controls.name: Documented challenge/resolution/override log for review iterations
controls.quote: Challenge and rationale record

controls.name: Non-converging lines kicked back to owners for resubmission rather than silently overridden
controls.quote: with real authority to send submissions back

controls.name: Automated variance/exception flagging to triage review
controls.quote: a continuous variance-flagging property is an input to this step, not a substitute for it

controls.name: Mandatory downside-scenario stress test of the draft budget
controls.quote: re-applies the downside macro scenario as a stress test on the draft budget each round

controls.name: Policy/FX basis change during review surfaced as disclosed policy change
controls.quote: any such change must be surfaced as a disclosed policy change

controls.name: Asynchronous/store-and-forward review channel
controls.quote: asynchronous/batched written commentary as the default-supported cadence

controls.name: Board pack carries unsanitised judgment flags, unresolved challenges and supporting evidence
controls.quote: The pack must explicitly carry the downside macro scenario and the material judgment calls/exception flags surfaced during T6, unsanitised

controls.name: Board approval reserved to humans; no agent decision authority
controls.quote: the approval action and authority remain exclusively with the board

controls.name: Board approval recorded with conditions; conditions reconciled before lock
controls.quote: Any conditions attached to approval ('approved subject to X') are explicitly recorded

controls.name: Lock hard-gated on verified board-approval artefact
controls.quote: A Lock Agent is hard-wired to trigger only on receipt of the board-approved artefact from T7

controls.name: Automated hash/diff match of loaded version against board-approved document
controls.quote: a validation mismatch halts the lock and escalates rather than proceeding silently or partially

controls.name: Named human attestation that locked version equals board-approved version before lock commits
controls.quote: attests, on every lock event including clean ones, that the loaded/locked figures are identical to the board-approved document

controls.name: Lock confirmer distinct from consolidation preparer / loader
controls.quote: a named accountable individual distinct from whoever last touched the consolidation run

controls.name: Governed, logged, authorised re-open procedure for post-lock changes
controls.quote: any post-lock correction must go through a formal, logged, CFO-authorised re-open procedure

controls.name: Documented manual/file-based lock fallback with same attestation/immutability discipline
controls.quote: Units without tier-one EPM licensing retain a documented manual-lock fallback (access-controlled file/version control)

controls.name: Durable vendor-independent export of locked budget
controls.quote: The locked version is exported to a durable, vendor-independent format

controls.name: Archive of assumption set and capex business cases at lock
controls.quote: Archived assumption set and capex business cases

controls.name: Named successor for displaced manual-loading role in transition plan
controls.quote: successor to the former manual-loading role, explicitly named in the transition plan

controls.name: Agent advisory only; owner's signed submission is the submission of record
controls.quote: the BU head remains the accountable author

controls.name: Above-threshold capex business case remains human-authored (agent limited to calculations)
controls.quote: a written business case that a human writes and a human reads

controls.name: Intake validation agent flags submission anomalies back to owner
controls.quote: An intake-validation agent checks submissions against assumptions, prior actuals and internal consistency and flags anomalies

controls.name: Degraded-mode logging on connector failure without blocking owner
controls.quote: on connector failure the agent falls back to a prior-year template and logs the degraded mode without blocking the BU head

controls.name: Target-setting kept separate from assumption issuance for attributable accountability
controls.quote: Set top-down targets

controls.name: Cost-centre budgeting kept distinct from revenue planning for single-owner traceability
controls.quote: kept as a structurally distinct step from T3 because the actor, approval chain and downstream consumers
